title: Meat Loving Florida Woman Swipes Tons of Sausages from Walmart: Cops
description:
A Florida woman was arrested after allegedly trying to steal more than $300 worth of groceries from a Marion County Walmart. Police took Jessica Zamudio, 45, into custody after loss prevention employees allegedly spotted her going into the bathroom with various merchandise, including packages of hot dogs and sausages, before trying to leave the store.
